_README: LooneyBin car-radio schedule. Host this file at a STABLE public URL (e.g. https://projectloonybin.com/radio.json).
The GAME SERVER polls it (~every 60s) and broadcasts the current track per station to players -- NO restart needed to change it.
HARD RULE: 'id' must be a PACKED song (a CfgSounds class already in the mission). Arma cannot stream audio from the web --
the .ogg files themselves must be packed into the mission. Workflow: you give the .ogg files -> I pack them + hand you back
the 'id' for each -> you drop those ids into this JSON. Adding a NEW song = one deploy to pack it; after that, reorder / move
between stations / rename stations / change genres FREELY from this file, live.
'len' = song length in WHOLE seconds (used to auto-advance + keep every listener on the same track). Get it right or tracks drift.
The station loops its playlist forever; 'what's playing now' is computed from wall-clock so everyone tuned to a station hears the
same song at the same time (a real broadcast). The driver picks the STATION; the station's content comes from here.
